acceptanceCriteria: Determine from accepted CAL060/061 and original owner intent whether administrative policy/init/pause/cutover writers are required to retain checkpoints; preserve the distinction between missing coverage and confirmed defects.

Use legitimate disposable native store/CLI writers to observe checkpoint presence, freshness, subsequent read mode and audit cost before/after administrative mutation and normal CREATE control; no synthetic authoritative cache or hidden state rewrite.
Retain focused regression evidence or an explicit documented exclusion with correct complete-audit fallback; never make read commands write checkpoint state.
Deduplicate/link the resulting disposition with V1-0644 and retain version, immutable source, actual outcome and unmeasured limits.
body: Suspected capability/contract coverage question, NOT a confirmed correctness defect. Dedup administrative search found none; checkpoint search found owning performance bug V1-0644 (GitHub446), whose body covers derived checkpoint read scaling, not administrative writer boundaries. During PR456 integration fixture at committed14eaf5e251691976b6cc81421c9d07a44c701dbe (owning policy/mutate/guards source unchanged from publicMAINf51f3c9e6fbfc5a6b219692e8bf46e4e43297a36), newLeaseStore plus legitimate PolicyUpdate left no checkpoint. Both proposed present/absent fixture setups failed the initial checkpoint stat; a legitimate CREATE ticket writer seeds and refreshes one and all final refusal tests pass. Source policy.go29 delegates administrativeWrite; retained source slice and search show retainCheckpoint only mutate.go104 and lease_write.go290, with guards.go104 defining the helper. Administrative PolicyUpdate path was not found retaining it. Writer-context marker only resamples time, not checkpoint retention. Expected behavior depends on accepted CAL060 interpretation: does every successfully audited administrative writer retain the derived cache, or is its omission an intentional complete-audit fallback? Correctness loss or user-visible performance regression NOT_OBSERVED; next-read mode/cost and full native CLI administrative paths NOT_MEASURED. No product source change was made. Reproduce with private legitimate fixture policy writer, checkpointPath presence/readmode before and after, then a normal CREATE writer control; never hand-write authoritative checkpoint. Installed Core163/Tasks202 developer runtime qualification unchanged. Corvint-first context admin-checkpoint-context-corrected.json and actual setup/control logs in /private/tmp/corvint-codex-batch.S53nDh/builder456-main/{fixture-final.log,fixture-final-repaired.log,fixture-source-manifest.json}; baseline /bin/ps sandbox refusal separately retained, no product defect inferred. Current integration key/plan/gates unaffected.
